description: This file defines options and configuration handling for the CSR Signing Controller in Kubernetes, including flag definitions, application of options to configuration, and validation logic.

classes.name: CSRSigningControllerOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for the CSR Signing Controller, including methods to add command-line flags, apply options to configuration, and validate options.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Adds command-line flags related to CSRSigningController options to a given FlagSet.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies the options to a CSRSigningControllerConfiguration object.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the CSRSigningControllerOptions for correctness and consistency.
